blocks.text: Barding is a skill about performing music. This text is a placeholder: the real guide text will be written from the design document and kept in this file.
Use the list on the left to browse the guide.
Challenge a local or master musician to a duel. Musician Duels are unlocked by completing A Noteworthy Duel.
Finish with a higher performance score than your opponent without losing all your health.

items: Adjust your tempo and volume to match the audience's yells.
Green music notes increase the rate you gain performance score.
Red zigzag notes reduce the rate you gain performance score.
Purple rest symbols heal music damage from your opponent.
Blue clef symbols charge your special attack faster.
Time your special attack to stun or damage your opponent.
A big exp drop for a win, or a small one for a loss.
Each win has a 1/25 chance to reward your opponent's legendary instrument.

blocks.text: Electric string instruments, Thudsticks or Thudmallots, and wind-imbued mouthpieces make your special attack more effective and increase performance score by 2.5%.
